acknowledgement.title: ACKNOWLEDGEMENT OF COUNTRY
paragraphs: PLACEHOLDER — needs Traditional Owner approval before launch. The gathering is held in Cairns, on the Country of the Gimuy Walubara Yidinji people, with Yirrganydji Country along the coast. Confirm the correct naming with local Traditional Owners and have them write or approve this wording. Do not reuse another event's Acknowledgement. See questionnaire section 4.

slides.heading: Where Collective Knowledge Leads To Collective Strength
paragraphs: Woven is a global initiative grounded in the sacredness of ancestral knowledge, responsibilities, and aspirations. We steward projects and campaigns centred on climate action, land defence, and Indigenous rights and self-determination.

slides.heading: Strengthening Our Planet And Our Rights Together
paragraphs: Woven transforms solutions to the climate crisis through the advancement of Indigenous rights, wisdom, and sovereignty. We are the only global Indigenous organisation dedicated exclusively to climate justice.

slides.heading: Research, Convening, Ancestral Knowledge, Network
paragraphs: Our framework is focused on four key areas: research, global convening, ancestral knowledge, and network building. Each one carries the others.

slides.heading: Dreaming Into Our Future
paragraphs: Over five days we come together to strengthen collective Indigenous-led climate justice strategies, promote the integration of traditional ecological knowledge into global climate solutions and policies, and foster a powerful, unified voice.

slides.heading: A Movement Built By And For Indigenous Peoples
paragraphs: We aim to amplify local movements and solutions, sharing Indigenous stories, knowledge, and wisdom — and to leave with a shared plan for action.
